text:
Anita: quick q — when a Dedicated GPU pool hits capacity and we fallback to a cheaper hosted model, what's the affordance surface supposed to look like in the Autoscale panel? Marco: hmm good call. current mocks just swap the model pill and show a toast. feels too subtle. :thinking: Jamal: agreed, users need to know when perf/cost changes. can we show an inline bar between min/max that says 'Fallback active — hosted model; expected +120ms latency' ? Emily: +1 on inline, but we should avoid hard numbers unless calibrated. maybe 'expect slightly higher latency' and a chevron to expand details. Mike: copy nit: 'slightly higher latency' is vague. Ops wants a ballpark ms for SLOs. Could show ranges: ~+50–200ms depending on sequence length. Anita: ops wants ranges, design wants concise. compromise: show short label and an accessible details panel with ranges and link to perf doc. Marco: accessibility: this should be an aria-live region so screen readers announce fallback. Also keyboard focus when fallback first happens (not a full modal). ux-bot: checklist: aria-live="polite", focusable container with role=region, visible contrast >=4.5:1 on banners. Jamal: UX question — where does this live relative to the SLO slider? If it's between min/max, could confuse users who think it affects SLO. Maybe an inline chip next to 'Pool: dedicated' that expands. Emily: what's the expected behavior for the SLO slider when fallback is active? Should the slider lock? Marco: don't lock. But gray out the 'achievable' indicator and show tooltip explaining fallbacks may change latency. Mike: also consider the burst toggle: if burst triggers a fallback we need the same affordance, but callout copy should reference burst specifically (e.g., 'Burst triggered — fallback to hosted'). Anita: copy proposals: 1) Inline chip: "Fallback active — hosted model (may increase latency)" 2) Expanded detail title: "Fallback triggered by capacity constraints" 3) Detail body: "When Dedicated pool is full, requests route to our hosted runtime. Estimated latency impact: typically +50–200ms; see perf guide." Thoughts? Jamal: prefer shorter chip text, proposal 1 is fine. move ranges into details. Emily: a11y: ensure the chip has aria-expanded and keyboard interaction (Enter/Space to open). Also ensure color-only indication has icon (⚠️). Marco: visual: use a subtle orange 2px left border, not full ribbon. Place chip immediately after pool selector so it's visually associated with pool. Mike: one more edge: what if there are multiple fallbacks (region + model variant)? details panel should list them as bullets and call out which one is active for this request. Anita: yeah list items, and include a 'what to do' CTA: 'Reserve more capacity' (links to Dedicated quota flow) and 'Adjust SLO' that opens the slider preset modal. ux-bot: suggested aria snippet for the region: ```
details...
``` Anita: ok final decisions: - show chip next to pool selector with icon + concise copy - chip opens accessible details panel (aria-live, role=region) - move numeric ranges to details, include link to perf doc - add two CTAs in details: Reserve capacity / Adjust SLO - same pattern for burst-triggered fallback but copy mentions 'burst' - visuals: small orange left border, 16px icon, contrast checked by design Marco: I'll update mocks and add keyboard interaction states. tagging @Emily for accessibility review when ready. Emily: will review once mocks live — will test with NVDA/VoiceOver. Mike: I'll sync with infra on what latency ranges to include in perf doc link. Anita: awesome. can we do a quick follow-up thread after mocks? thanks all :thumbsup: Marco: sure — will drop updated art by EOD tomorrow. Jamal: nice — this will make fallbacks less spooky for customers. :)
